GenAiPromptTemplate.description: This template is used to generate patient summary to be shared with Doctor 15 minutes before the appointment
GenAiPromptTemplate.masterLabel: Template for Patient Summary to Doctor

templateVersions.content: Please generate a message addressed to Dr. {!$Input:Doctor_Name}, informing him of his upcoming appointment in the next 15 minutes. The appointment will last for {!$Input:Clinical_Encounter.ServiceAppointment.Duration} minutes with a patient named {!$Input:Patient.FirstName} {!$Input:Patient.LastName}. Ensure to include a patient summary using the following details: Patient Details: {!$RecordSnapshot:Patient.Snapshot} Additionally, the patient has reported the following symptoms for this appointment: {!$Input:Clinical_Encounter.Reason__c} When crafting the message, be sure to include any notable mentions in the reason and outcome fields of the Clinical Encounter for this patient. Please base your response strictly on the instructions and provided details. Do not mention details such as ID, last modified dates, or created dates under any circumstances.
